repair.note: Field repair by the crew (M11.7a; research 2026-11-16 from search extracts only, no authoritative timetable found). Crews fix only light damage: a broken track with two spare links (forums: about 1.5 h for a broken track, a complete track change 1 h 20 with 5-6 men: 90 man-minutes here, two men, restored to 0.8), a holed wheel side on an 8x8 (Boxer run-flat inserts and tyre pressure control, BTR-82A drives on holed tyres: no part, 40 man-minutes, back to 0.5 = limping), the coaxial machine gun (spare barrel, 10 min, works with chance 0.6) and the radio (15 min, chance 0.5: a damaged set is often beyond the crew). Everything else (engine, transmission, gun, turret drive, stabiliser, sights, ammunition, fuel) is recovery or workshop work. Order of the tasks: mobility first (Bundeswehr 'Funken, Fahren, Feuern' adapted: a mobile hull can get out). Quiet before work: no hit for 60 s, the crew not under fire for 20 s, no enemy known within 300 m for work outside the hull (game values). Work rate per man 1 + 0.5 x (experience - 0.5), the driver (the mechanic) x1.25, at least 0.25. Workshop days at condition 0 per component kind: campaign input for the settlement of M11.7b (game values). All values low.
